physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Local Group is recorded here: it is a group of galaxies seen from inside. Its page is centred on a star, and its package frames the view with a sphere of the nominal solar radius, 695,700 km (IAU 2015 Resolution B3), a presentation value. The group's zero-velocity surface radius is R_LG = 1060 +/- 70 kpc, McConnachie (2012), AJ 144, 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1204.1562), section 3.

sources.position: The mid-point of the vector connecting the Milky Way and M31, where McConnachie (2012), AJ 144, 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1204.1562), Table 2 notes to columns 8 to 10, places the barycentre of the Local Group. Computed 2026-10-01 from this repository's records of the Galactic centre (sgr-a-star.json) and M31 (m31.json).
sources.distance: The Sun's distance from that mid-point, from the same two records: 386146 pc. The paper adopts (m-M)0 = 24.47 for M31; the mid-point here uses the M31 distance this repository draws M31 at, so the marker sits between the two as drawn.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the group is held at this position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: a mid-point has no measured radial velocity; the group is held at its distance.
